channel.title: Projects on Navaneet J
channel.description: Recent content in Projects on Navaneet J

item.title: Game Boy Emulator
item.description: A Game Boy (DMG) emulator written in C++, built from scratch to understand the CPU, memory system, graphics, and interrupts.

item.title: 6502 Emulator
item.description: A cycle-counted NMOS 6502 emulator with memory-mapped I/O, interrupts, and a real ca65/ld65 assembler toolchain. Passes the Klaus Dormann functional test suite.

item.title: myos
item.description: A tiny x86 OS built from a 512-byte boot sector up — real mode to protected mode, GDT setup, and a path toward a real kernel.

item.title: Smartwatch Firmware
item.description: ESP-IDF firmware for a DIY smartwatch driving a GC9A01 240x240 round SPI display, with a from-scratch display driver.
